summary: Default execution environments are Minimal (ansible-core 2.19 and Ansible Runner, no collections; the recommended base for custom images) and EE Supported (plus Red Hat-supported collections); customize by pulling ee-minimal and adding collections.
questions: What is the difference between ee-minimal and ee-supported?
Which ansible-core version is in the AAP 2.6 minimal execution environment?
